title: Edison What Happened

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Alright, so! Thankfully the orphans are good for now. A-O-K. What about on your end? Did you find the Notary?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, so! Thankfully the orphans are good for now. A-O-K. What about on your end? Did you find the Notary?
Here you go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Cirian was not happy to see me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cirian was not happy to see me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Cirian was not happy to see me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Cirian was not happy to see me.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Did you get the ID cards? Tell me you got the ID cards...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you get the ID cards? Tell me you got the ID cards...
I didn't.
You need to calm down.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Bastard-corpster-greed-filled-mother-ahhh! Seriously? One thing. We agreed you could handle one. Very. Simple. Thing!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bastard-corpster-greed-filled-mother-ahhh! Seriously? One thing. We agreed you could handle one. Very. Simple. Thing!
Well, I didn't.
I'm sorry! I tried.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I'm aware. Alright. Okay... We got this. It's okay. Where did you find Cirian?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm aware. Alright. Okay... We got this. It's okay. Where did you find Cirian?
Helix Monumental.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Then I guess that's where I'm going. Least I could pull off my part of the deal. You... just.... unbelievable. I'll be back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I guess that's where I'm going. Least I could pull off my part of the deal. You... just.... unbelievable. I'll be back.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Hot as a bowl of mango-spiced grub! You actually did it. Not that I doubted you. Well, okay, I doubted you a little but hey, this world's full of doubt. Know you doubted whether or not I could get that fine lifted.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hot as a bowl of mango-spiced grub! You actually did it. Not that I doubted you. Well, okay, I doubted you a little but hey, this world's full of doubt. Know you doubted whether or not I could get that fine lifted.
Is it really gone?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Like one's inhibition as soon as they step foot in Club Oralange. Lotta people get tongue-tied in that place if yah know what I mean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like one's inhibition as soon as they step foot in Club Oralange. Lotta people get tongue-tied in that place if yah know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Cirian mentioned you owe her money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cirian mentioned you owe her money.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Cirian mentioned you owe her money.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Cirian mentioned you owe her money.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Huh. Did she now? And here I thought we were still abiding by friendly confidentiality. Well then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh. Did she now? And here I thought we were still abiding by friendly confidentiality. Well then.
Should talk to her.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I know. I have to and I will once I figure this all out. Thanks for getting the cards. Here's what I got for yah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, yeah, I know. I have to and I will once I figure this all out. Thanks for getting the cards. Here's what I got for yah.
Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: You wanna make some more? It's not much, still replenishing stocks after I had to pay a few people off. Greedy sons of motherboards.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You wanna make some more? It's not much, still replenishing stocks after I had to pay a few people off. Greedy sons of motherboards.
Can't risk it.
What does it entail?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Nothing more than dropping those cards off at the class room.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing more than dropping those cards off at the class room.
And where is that?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Place in the Stacks. You can just put em in the drop-box out front. Those kids aren't gonna open the door for someone they don't know. Not with Mica Rain casually walking around.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Place in the Stacks. You can just put em in the drop-box out front. Those kids aren't gonna open the door for someone they don't know. Not with Mica Rain casually walking around.
That ***** is still around?
You've seen Mica?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Flash cams caught her in the neighborhood, about seventy-five yards from the hideout. That woman is death in their minds.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Flash cams caught her in the neighborhood, about seventy-five yards from the hideout. That woman is death in their minds.
I'll keep an eye out.
Don't doubt that you will.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I'm asking, right here in front of you, help me. I have to know what happened to my niece Haley.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm asking, right here in front of you, help me. I have to know what happened to my niece Haley.
I can't Edison.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine. What do I have to do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine. What do I have to do?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fine. What do I have to do?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fine. What do I have to do?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: It's okay. I'll see you on the next run through.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's okay. I'll see you on the next run through.
You owe me 15,000 Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She won't be able to mention it anymore.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She won't be able to mention it anymore.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She won't be able to mention it anymore.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She won't be able to mention it anymore.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: You... you paid Cirian what I owed them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You... you paid Cirian what I owed them?
I did.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I don't know what to say. Honestly. This... this is too much and you are too good'a person. Can't tell you the last time I hung around with genuinely good people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know what to say. Honestly. This... this is too much and you are too good'a person. Can't tell you the last time I hung around with genuinely good people.
